_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: flat 30d momentum, subdued funding, and range absorption keep the score pinned; HOLD is the graded call until a real range break appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicitly HOLD/coil; narrative silent on forward phase but inflow print is cautionary, not a long trigger — no shared directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: Price and momentum remain mid-range flat with funding near zero and no range expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum leaves mid-range with funding lift (up toward Optimism) or CVD/longs unwind through the range (down toward Disbelief)
